window: Past 24 hours. A light day: the Oct. 4 boat strike and most other recent items were already published in the Oct. 5 edition.

stories.headline: CBP finds 47 pounds of cocaine in 18 packages inside a car at the Laredo bridge
stories.summary: Officers at the Juarez-Lincoln Bridge sent a Nissan Rogue to secondary inspection on Sept. 30, where a dog and a scanner revealed 18 packages of cocaine worth about $628,000.
